steps.title: Discovery, pilot, build, then run or hand over
steps.lede: Each step ends with something you keep, even if you stop there.
steps.reassure: You see it working on your own data before you commit to the full build.

items.title: Discovery
items.body: We pick one job, the systems it touches and who checks the result. You get a written scope and a fixed price for the pilot.

items.title: Pilot
items.body: The smallest version that does the real job on your real data, with a person approving anything important. Then: go ahead, change it or stop.

items.title: Build
items.body: The finished system, connected to your tools, tested and in your own code repository.

items.title: Run or hand over
items.body: We run it for you with monitoring and cost reports, or hand it to your team with training.

trust.title: Fast, with people in charge

points.title: A person approves anything important
points.body: The agent drafts and prepares. Anything that sends, spends or deletes waits for a named person.

points.title: You own the code and the data
points.body: Everything we write is in your own code repository from day one. Your data and keys stay with you.

points.title: It runs where you choose
points.body: In your cloud, on your own machines, or managed by us. You can even keep the AI model in-house.

points.title: Built by a team that runs its own agents
points.body: Our own agents run our business every day, on the same software we use for clients.

brandPage.title: The Lattice system
brandPage.lede: Logo, colour, type and components for TenthMatrix, shown in both themes. This page is the design review surface and is not indexed.
brandPage.logoLede: Nine cells and one more: the grid is the model, the tenth cell is the agent. The mark stays crisp at 16 px.
brandPage.paletteLede: Ink on paper, one signal. Ratios are WCAG 2.2 contrast against the theme background (text and controls) or the theme text colour (surfaces).
brandPage.contrastNote: Text needs 4.5:1, control borders 3:1. Hairlines are decorative.
brandPage.typeLede: Bricolage Grotesque for display, Instrument Sans for body and UI, IBM Plex Mono for code, data and eyebrows.
brandPage.componentsLede: Buttons, pills, cards, form controls, code and article typography, side by side in light and dark.
brandPage.iconsLede: One set, one stroke weight, accent only for the active item.
